versos.hebraico: בְּךָֽ־יְהוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל־אֵב֥וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
controles.kjv: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
controles.livre: Em ti, SENHOR, confio; nunca me deixes ser envergonhado.

versos.hebraico: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אָ֝זְנְךָ֗ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
controles.kjv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
controles.livre: Resgata-me e livra-me por tua justiça; inclina a mim teus ouvidos, e salva-me.

versos.hebraico: הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י׀ לְצ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן לָב֗וֹא תָּמִ֗יד צִוִּ֥יתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֖י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָֽתָּה׃

controles.web: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
controles.kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
controles.livre: Sê tu minha rocha e minha habitação, para continuamente eu me abrigar nela; tu tens ordenado que eu seja salvo, porque tu és minha rocha forte e minha fortaleza.

versos.hebraico: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י פַּ֭לְּטֵנִי מִיַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִכַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְחוֹמֵץ׃

controles.web: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
controles.kjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
controles.livre: Meu Deus, livra-me da dominação do perverso, das mãos do injusto e cruel;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְ֝הוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥י מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃

controles.web: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh; my confidence from my youth.
controles.kjv: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: thou art my trust from my youth.
controles.livre: Pois tu és minha esperança, ó Senhor DEUS; tu és minha confiança desde minha juventude.

versos.hebraico: עָלֶ֤יךָ׀ נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי מִבֶּ֗טֶן מִמְּעֵ֣י אִ֭מִּי אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑י בְּךָ֖ תְהִלָּתִ֣י תָמִֽיד׃

controles.web: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
controles.kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
controles.livre: Tenho me apoiado em ti desde o ventre de minha mãe; das entranhas dela me tiraste; eu louvo continuamente a ti.

versos.hebraico: כְּ֭מוֹפֵת הָיִ֣יתִי לְרַבִּ֑ים וְ֝אַתָּ֗ה מַֽחֲסִי־עֹֽז׃

controles.web: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
controles.kjv: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
controles.livre: Para muitos fui como prodígio, porém tu és meu forte refúgio.

versos.hebraico: יִמָּ֣לֵא פִ֭י תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ כָּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all the day.
controles.kjv: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
controles.livre: Minha boca seja cheia de louvores a ti por tua glória o dia todo.

versos.hebraico: אַֽל־תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה כִּכְל֥וֹת כֹּ֝חִ֗י אַֽל־תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
controles.kjv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
controles.livre: Não me rejeites no tempo da velhice; não me desampares quando minha força se acabar;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אָמְר֣וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃

controles.web: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
controles.kjv: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
controles.livre: Porque meus inimigos falam contra mim, e os que espiam minha alma tomam conselhos juntos uns com os outros;

versos.hebraico: לֵ֭אמֹר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֲזָב֑וֹ רִֽדְפ֥וּ וְ֝תִפְשׂ֗וּהוּ כִּי־אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃

controles.web: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
controles.kjv: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
controles.livre: Dizendo: Deus o desamparou; persegui, e o tomai, pois já não há quem o livre.

versos.hebraico: אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חישה׃

controles.web: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
controles.kjv: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
controles.livre: Deus, não fiques longe de mim; Deus meu, apressa-te para me socorrer.

versos.hebraico: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ שֹׂטְנֵ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יַֽעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּכְלִמָּ֑ה מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃

controles.web: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
controles.kjv: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
controles.livre: Sejam envergonhados e pereçam os adversários de minha alma; cubram-se de humilhação e confusão aqueles que procuram fazer mal a mim.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭אֲנִי תָּמִ֣יד אֲיַחֵ֑ל וְ֝הוֹסַפְתִּ֗י עַל־כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
controles.kjv: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
controles.livre: Porém eu continuamente manterei a esperança, e darei todo o louvor a ti ainda mais.

versos.hebraico: פִּ֤י׀ יְסַפֵּ֬ר צִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ כָּל־הַיּ֥וֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹ֖א יָדַ֣עְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
controles.kjv: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
controles.livre: Minha boca contará tua justiça, e tua salvação o dia todo, ainda que eu não saiba sua medida.

versos.hebraico: אָב֗וֹא בִּ֭גְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אַזְכִּ֖יר צִדְקָתְךָ֣ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
controles.kjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
controles.livre: Irei adiante pelos poderes do Senhor DEUS; anunciarei tua justiça, que é somente tua.

versos.hebraico: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י וְעַד־הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
controles.kjv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
controles.livre: Deus, tu tens me ensinado desde minha juventude; e até agora conto tuas maravilhas.

versos.hebraico: וְגַ֤ם עַד־זִקְנָ֨ה׀ וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים אַֽל־תַּעַ֫זְבֵ֥נִי עַד־אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכָל־יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
controles.kjv: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
controles.livre: E agora, que estou velho e de cabelos grisalhos, não me desampares, Deus; enquanto eu não tiver anunciado a força de teu braço a esta geração, e teu poder a todos que vierem.

versos.hebraico: וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַד־מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִ֣י כָמֽוֹךָ׃

controles.web: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
controles.kjv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
controles.livre: E tua justiça, Senhor, alcança as alturas; porque tu tens feito grandes coisas. Quem é como tu, ó Deus?

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הראיתנו׀ צָר֥וֹת רַבּ֗וֹת וְרָ֫ע֥וֹת תָּשׁ֥וּב תחיינו וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
controles.kjv: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
controles.livre: Tu, que me fizeste ver muitos males e aflições, voltarás a me dar vida; e voltarás a me tirar dos abismos da terra.

versos.hebraico: תֶּ֤רֶב׀ גְּֽדֻלָּתִ֗י וְתִסֹּ֥ב תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Increase my honor, and comfort me again.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
controles.livre: Tu aumentarás minha honra e voltarás para me consolar.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־אֲנִ֤י׀ אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֪ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
controles.kjv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
controles.livre: Eu também te louvarei com instrumento de cordas pela tua fidelidade, ó meu Deus; cantarei a ti com harpa, ó Santo de Israel.

versos.hebraico: תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּ֑ךְ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ׃

controles.web: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
controles.kjv: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
controles.livre: Meus lábios terão muita alegria, porque cantarei a ti; e também se alegrará a minha alma, que tu tens resgatado.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִ֗י כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ כִּי־בֹ֥שׁוּ כִֽי־חָ֝פְר֗וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽי׃

controles.web: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
controles.kjv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
controles.livre: Minha língua também falará de tua justiça o dia todo, pois já estão envergonhados e humilhados aqueles que procuram me fazer mal.
